description: Coffer v1 client protocol test vectors. HKDF = HKDF-SHA256, 32 zero-byte salt, 32-byte output. Hex values are lowercase; base64 is standard with padding; ct = ciphertext || 16-byte GCM tag.
notes: GET /api/v1/identity would return { envId, wrappedKey } with these values; decrypting wrappedKey with wrapKey and AAD 'coffer/v1/machine-key/<clientId>' must give envKeyHex.
GET /api/v1/secrets would return { secrets: [secret] }; decrypting it must give plaintextJson, whose name hashes to mac.

Encryption uses a random IV in real use. To compare ciphertext byte for byte, encrypt plaintextJson with the fixed secretIv; JSON from your language may escape differently, which is fine as long as other clients decode it.
